entries.seedCode: part of the world (Seed Code, preset, history)

en.short: Moves items around: what lies in the world and, if you turn them on, gifts, drops and shop stock.
en.what: The master switch of everything about items. When it is off, no item is moved and none of the item options do anything.
en.affects: Items in the world, NPC gifts, enemy drops, shops, starting classes and equipment, NPC outfits, key placement and item difficulty.
en.limits: It only has an effect together with at least one of the options below it. Key placement also needs "Items lying in the world".

pl.short: Przenosi przedmioty: to, co leży w świecie, oraz (jeśli włączysz) dary, łupy i towary sklepów.

entries.seedCode: part of the world (Seed Code, preset, history)

en.short: Shuffles what lies on the ground, in chests and on corpses.
en.what: The contents of the item pickups placed in the maps (things you pick up from the ground, from chests and from corpses) are shuffled between those places, so the item you find somewhere is usually not the one the original game puts there.
en.affects: Every pickup in the world except the ones the story depends on (those stay unless Key placement is on). It does not change what NPCs give, what enemies drop or what shops sell: those have their own options.
en.limits: Key placement, Split armor sets and the soul options need this one.
en.example: The Alluring Skulls that lie in the Undead Parish may turn up in the Duke's Archives instead.

pl.short: Tasuje to, co leży na ziemi, w skrzyniach i przy zwłokach.

dependencies.text: Turn on Item randomization to change this option.

entries.seedCode: part of the world (Seed Code, preset, history)

labels.en: Protect progression gifts and shop goods
labels.pl: Chroń dary i towary sklepowe ważne dla postępu

en.short: Keeps the Lordvessel gift, the Key to the Seal gift and story-bound shop goods where the game puts them.
en.what: While NPC gifts or Shops are shuffled, the two gifts the story depends on (the Lordvessel from Gwynevere and the Key to the Seal) are not added to the item pool, and shop goods that a story event unlocks stay where they are. A fixed list of safe goods, such as Humanity, is still shuffled.
en.affects: Only the NPC gifts and Shops pools.
en.limits: Does nothing when both NPC gifts and Shops are off. It is not what keeps keys in the world safe: that is done by the world pickup rules and by Key placement.

pl.short: Zostawia dar Lordvessel, dar Key to the Seal i towary sklepowe związane z fabułą tam, gdzie umieszcza je gra.

dependencies.text: Turn on Item randomization to change this option.

entries.seedCode: part of the world (Seed Code, preset, history)

en.short: Mixes the items NPCs give you into the item pool.
en.what: The items NPCs hand over (about twenty gifts) join the item pool: an NPC can give a different item, and the original gift can turn up somewhere else.
en.affects: Gifts given by NPCs through conversation or events.
en.limits: The Lordvessel and the Key to the Seal stay as they are while "Protect progression gifts and shop goods" is on.

pl.short: Dodaje przedmioty, które dają NPC, do puli przedmiotów.

dependencies.text: Turn on Item randomization to change this option.

entries.seedCode: part of the world (Seed Code, preset, history)

en.short: Mixes what enemies drop when they die into the item pool.
en.what: The items enemies can drop join the item pool: killing an enemy can give a different item, and the original drop can turn up somewhere else.
en.affects: Item drops of enemies (not the souls they give).
en.limits: This option does not change how likely a drop is. Use "Guaranteed enemy drops" for that.

pl.short: Dodaje to, co wypadają wrogowie po śmierci, do puli przedmiotów.

dependencies.text: Turn on Item randomization to change this option.

entries.seedCode: part of the world (Seed Code, preset, history)

en.short: Makes enemies that have a drop always drop one of its items.
en.what: The item chances of every enemy drop in the game are scaled up to a total of 100%, so an enemy with a drop table never drops nothing.
en.affects: Every enemy drop table, whether or not Enemy drops is on. It does not change which items are in the tables.
en.limits: Needs Item randomization turned on.

pl.short: Sprawia, że wróg mający łup zawsze upuszcza któryś ze swoich przedmiotów.

dependencies.text: Turn on Item randomization to change this option.

entries.seedCode: part of the world (Seed Code, preset, history)

en.short: Mixes the stock of NPC shops into the item pool.
en.what: The goods and equipment sold by NPC merchants join the item pool: a shop can sell other things, and what it sold can turn up somewhere else. Arrows, bolts and throwables stay as shop stock.
en.affects: Merchant inventories.
en.limits: Goods unlocked by story events stay while "Protect progression gifts and shop goods" is on. With DLC content turned off, the DLC merchants are left alone.

pl.short: Dodaje towary sklepów NPC do puli przedmiotów.

dependencies.text: Turn on Item randomization to change this option.

entries.seedCode: part of the world (Seed Code, preset, history)

en.short: Gives each class the starting stats of another class.
en.what: The starting stats (level and attributes) of the classes are shuffled between the classes, so no class keeps its own.
en.affects: The stats you start with when you pick a class. Their equipment is a separate option.
en.limits: Needs Item randomization turned on.
en.example: The Warrior may start with the attributes of the Sorcerer.

pl.short: Daje każdej klasie startowe statystyki innej klasy.

dependencies.text: Turn on Item randomization to change this option.

entries.seedCode: part of the world (Seed Code, preset, history)

en.short: Gives each class random starting weapons and armor.
en.what: Each class gets other weapons (a main-hand weapon and a left-hand item; Hunters, Sorcerers, Pyromancers and Clerics also a special item) and four other armor pieces. Weapons are chosen so the class can use them with the stats it ends up with, and armor is never repeated between classes.
en.affects: The starting gear of all classes (picked up in the Undead Asylum).
en.limits: The kind of weapons depends on "Starting weapon types". It works with or without "Starting class stats".
en.example: The Warrior may start with other weapons and other armor than the usual ones.

pl.short: Daje każdej klasie losową startową broń i zbroję.

dependencies.text: Turn on Item randomization to change this option.

entries.seedCode: part of the world (Seed Code, preset, history)

en.short: Chooses which weapons and shields the starting gear may contain.
en.what: Only used when Starting equipment is on. It decides how demanding the main-hand weapon may be (what the class can wield one-handed or two-handed with its own Strength) and whether the left hand holds a shield or may hold a weapon.
en.affects: The weapons and shields chosen for the classes' starting equipment.
en.limits: Disabled until "Starting equipment" is on: on its own it changes nothing.

pl.short: Wybiera, jakie bronie i tarcze może zawierać wyposażenie startowe.

shield-1h.label: Shield and a one-handed weapon
shield-1h.explanation: Main weapon usable one-handed with the class's Strength, and a shield in the left hand.

shield-2h.label: Shield and a one- or two-handed weapon
shield-2h.explanation: Main weapon may need two hands (up to 1.5 times the class's Strength) and a shield in the left hand.

mixed-pool.label: Any weapon in the left hand
mixed-pool.explanation: As above, but the left hand may hold any weapon the class can use, not only a shield.

dependencies.text: Turn on Item randomization to change this option.
Turn on Starting equipment to change this option.

entries.seedCode: part of the world (Seed Code, preset, history)
part of the world (Seed Code, preset, history)
part of the world (Seed Code, preset, history)
part of the world (Seed Code, preset, history)

en.short: Decides whether the keys that open the world are moved.
en.what: Keys are the items the world needs to progress (for example the Basement Key, the Master Key, the Crest of Artorias and the bell keys). The modes move them to other world pickups and check the result so every area stays reachable and the Firelink Altar can be reached.
en.affects: The placement of key items. Item difficulty, Lordvessel placement and Lord Soul placement build on it.
en.limits: Needs "Items lying in the world". Race Mode + is always Fair. With the fog randomizer on, Race Mode + is made as Race Mode.

pl.short: Decyduje, czy klucze otwierające świat są przenoszone.

vanilla.label: Original
vanilla.explanation: Every key stays where the game puts it.

shuffled.label: Shuffled
shuffled.explanation: Keys move to other pickups; a safety check keeps the world completable.

race.label: Race Mode
race.explanation: Like Shuffled, but keys and embers lie only in boss rewards, chests and the places where keys normally are. Good for races.

race-plus.label: Race Mode +
race-plus.explanation: Like Race Mode, but the world may need skips and glitches (the Capra skip, the Seal skip...); you can get stuck without them.

dependencies.text: Turn on Item randomization to change this option.
Key placement needs "Items lying in the world": turn it on, or the world cannot be made.

entries.seedCode: part of the world (Seed Code, preset, history)

en.short: Moves the Lordvessel to another pickup.
en.what: The Lordvessel joins the key shuffle: it lies at another pickup in the world, and Gwynevere hands over another item from the pool instead. The Firelink Altar still needs the Lordvessel in your inventory.
en.affects: The Lordvessel and Gwynevere's gift.
en.limits: Needs a Key placement other than Original. Not related to the golden fog gates of the fog randomizer.

pl.short: Przenosi Lordvessel do innego znaleziska.

dependencies.text: Turn on Item randomization to change this option.
Choose a Key placement other than Original to change this option.

entries.seedCode: part of the world (Seed Code, preset, history)

en.short: Moves the four Lord Souls to other pickups.
en.what: The four Lord Souls (Bed of Chaos, Nito, Seath and the Four Kings) join the key shuffle and can be found elsewhere. They are boss rewards, so the boss fights themselves stay where they are.
en.affects: The pickups of the Lord Souls and the items that lie there instead.
en.limits: Needs a Key placement other than Original. Not related to "Require Lord Souls" in the fog randomizer.

pl.short: Przenosi cztery Lord Souls do innych znalezisk.

dependencies.text: Turn on Item randomization to change this option.
Choose a Key placement other than Original to change this option.

entries.seedCode: part of the world (Seed Code, preset, history)

en.short: How strongly good items are kept out of easy places.
en.what: It only decides which of the allowed places an item prefers; it can never make a world impossible to finish. Fair puts items anywhere with equal chance. Unfair keeps desirable items out of plain view. Very Unfair hides them and rarely puts them in early areas. DS1TR rates items and places by its own rules from game data, so this approximates the original tool.
en.affects: Where items are placed in the pools you turned on (world, gifts, drops, shops).
en.limits: Race Mode + is always Fair.

pl.short: Jak mocno dobre przedmioty są trzymane z dala od łatwych miejsc.

fair.label: Fair
fair.explanation: Items have an equal chance to be placed anywhere.

unfair.label: Unfair
unfair.explanation: Desirable items are not placed in plain view.

very-unfair.label: Very Unfair
very-unfair.explanation: Desirable items are hidden and rarely lie in early areas.

dependencies.text: Turn on Item randomization to change this option.
Race Mode + is always Fair.

entries.seedCode: part of the world (Seed Code, preset, history)

en.short: What happens to souls and boss souls as items.
en.what: Souls you can pick up (Soul of a Lost Undead and so on) and boss souls are items too. Normally they are shuffled like any other item.
en.affects: Soul items in the pools you turned on (world, gifts, drops).
en.limits: Needs at least one of: Items lying in the world, NPC gifts, Enemy drops.

pl.short: Co dzieje się z duszami i duszami bossów jako przedmiotami.

shuffled.label: Shuffled like other items
shuffled.explanation: Souls are shuffled like any other item.

replaced.label: Smaller souls become other items
replaced.explanation: The smaller souls (Soul of a Lost Undead to Soul of a Great Hero) become other consumables before shuffling.

transposed.label: Boss souls may become weapons
transposed.explanation: Boss souls join the pool, and each has a 75% chance to become a weapon made from that soul.

dependencies.text: Turn on Item randomization to change this option.
Needs at least one of: Items lying in the world, NPC gifts, Enemy drops.

entries.seedCode: part of the world (Seed Code, preset, history)

en.short: On: armor pieces are found separately. Off: whole armor sets stay together.
en.what: On, every armor piece is shuffled on its own, so one set can be spread over many places. Off, the regular armor sets found in the world are exchanged as complete sets between places that hold a set.
en.affects: Armor found in the world.
en.limits: Needs "Items lying in the world". Also changes how NPC outfits are mixed when "NPC outfits" is on.
en.example: Off: the Antiquated Dress, Gloves and Skirt, which lie together in Darkroot, stay together as one set at another place.

pl.short: Włączone: elementy zbroi znajdujesz osobno. Wyłączone: całe zestawy zbroi zostają razem.

dependencies.text: Turn on Item randomization to change this option.
Turn on Items lying in the world to change this option.

entries.seedCode: part of the world (Seed Code, preset, history)

en.short: NPCs wear armor pieces that other NPCs wear.
en.what: NPC characters wear armor pieces other NPCs already wear instead of their usual sets. Only their look and their armor stats change. With Split armor sets turned off each NPC wears one complete set; turned on, the pieces are mixed. Hollowed versions keep their look.
en.affects: How NPCs look. Nothing you can pick up changes.
en.limits: Needs Item randomization turned on.

pl.short: NPC noszą elementy zbroi, które noszą inni NPC.

dependencies.text: Turn on Item randomization to change this option.

entries.seedCode: part of the world (Seed Code, preset, history)

en.short: Replaces enemies in the world with other enemies and bosses.
en.what: The master switch of everything about enemies and bosses. When it is off, no enemy or boss is changed.
en.affects: Regular enemies, bosses and all their options.
en.limits: Boss randomization is a separate switch below it.

pl.short: Zastępuje wrogów w świecie innymi wrogami i bossami.

entries.seedCode: part of the world (Seed Code, preset, history)

en.short: Replaces regular enemies with other enemies.
en.what: Regular (non-boss) enemies are replaced according to the placement method and the options below it.
en.affects: Every regular enemy in the game.
en.limits: Needs Enemy randomization turned on.

pl.short: Zastępuje zwykłych wrogów innymi wrogami.

dependencies.text: Turn on Enemy randomization to change this option.

entries.seedCode: part of the world (Seed Code, preset, history)

en.short: How strong a replaced enemy is.
en.what: When an enemy is replaced, this decides whether the new enemy keeps its own health and damage or takes those of the enemy it replaced.
en.affects: Health and damage multipliers of replaced enemies.
en.limits: Needs Enemy randomization turned on.

pl.short: Jak silny jest zastąpiony wróg.

vanilla.label: Own strength
vanilla.explanation: The new enemy keeps its own strength, so a strong enemy can stand in an early area.

area.label: By area
area.explanation: The new enemy takes the strength of the enemy that stood there before.

progressive.label: Progressive
progressive.explanation: In this version identical to "By area" (the generated game files are byte for byte the same).

dependencies.text: Turn on Enemy randomization to change this option.

entries.seedCode: part of the world (Seed Code, preset, history)

en.short: How replacements are chosen.
en.what: Pick a replacement for every spot: each enemy spot independently chooses a compatible replacement, which turns on the replacement chance, matching, difficulty, kind replacement, custom pool and the boss options; a kind may repeat. Shuffle existing enemies: the classic method, it shuffles the enemies that exist between places while keeping their numbers; it reproduces old seeds.
en.affects: All options of the enemy and boss sections that need the placement method.
en.limits: Changing it puts the options that depend on it back to their usual values for that method.

pl.short: Jak wybierane są zamienniki.

sampling-v1.label: Pick a replacement for every spot
sampling-v1.explanation: Each spot independently picks a compatible replacement (recommended). Turns on the options below.

permutation-v1.label: Shuffle existing enemies
permutation-v1.explanation: Shuffles the existing enemies between places, keeping their numbers. Reproduces old seeds.

dependencies.text: Turn on Enemy randomization to change this option.
Turn on Regular enemies to change this option.

entries.seedCode: part of the world (Seed Code, preset, history)

en.short: How likely each enemy spot is to be replaced at all.
en.what: The chance that a regular enemy spot takes part in the replacement. It is decided once for each spot (once for each kind with "Replace by kind"), before anything else, and does not depend on what the spot would receive. 100% means that every spot takes part; whether it then changes depends on the other options (with Only bosses a spot stays as it is only when a boss cannot stand there).
en.affects: How many regular enemies stay as in the original game.
en.limits: Only used with the placement method "Pick a replacement for every spot". The limit of 30 enemy models per map never gets worse.

pl.short: Jak prawdopodobne jest, że dane miejsce wroga w ogóle zostanie zastąpione.

dependencies.text: Turn on Enemy randomization to change this option.
Turn on Regular enemies to change this option.
Only used with the placement method "Pick a replacement for every spot".

entries.seedCode: part of the world (Seed Code, preset, history)

en.short: What regular enemy spots receive.
en.what: Decides what a regular enemy spot that takes part (see Replacement chance) receives: only regular enemies, only bosses, or either. A boss in a regular spot walks the world like a regular enemy (a roaming boss): it has no boss bar, no fog gate and no encounter reward, and it drops only a share of its souls (Roaming boss souls). Bosses that need their own arena (Bed of Chaos, Ceaseless Discharge, Dark Sun Gwyndolin, Lord Gwyn) and multi-body bosses never appear there.
en.affects: Regular enemy spots, including large regular enemies such as the Titanite Demons and the Drakes. The options for roaming bosses depend on it.
en.limits: Only used with the placement method "Pick a replacement for every spot". With Only bosses a spot stays as it is, and is never given a regular enemy instead, only when a boss cannot stand there: the spot is protected (some passive, scripted or ghost enemies), Size of replacements is "Only where they fit" and no boss fits, the Undead Asylum with an Easy Asylum matching mode, the matching rules or "No replacement by the same kind" leave no boss, or the map would load more than about 30 different models (bosses already in the map are reused, so this rarely matters). There is no limit on the number of bosses in a map, and the same boss can appear many times.

pl.short: Co dostają miejsca zwykłych wrogów.

none.label: Nothing (they stay)
none.explanation: Regular enemy spots are not replaced.

normals.label: Only regular enemies
normals.explanation: Only regular enemies take part (the usual replacement).

bosses.label: Only bosses
bosses.explanation: Every regular enemy selected for replacement receives a boss, as many as there are spots, the same boss as often as it comes up. A spot that cannot safely take a boss stays as it is.

both.label: Bosses or regular enemies
both.explanation: Each spot that takes part gets a boss with the chance set in the boss section, otherwise a regular enemy. At 100% every spot that takes part is offered a boss; a spot that cannot take one keeps the regular enemy chosen for it.

dependencies.text: Turn on Enemy randomization to change this option.
Turn on Regular enemies to change this option.
Only used with the placement method "Pick a replacement for every spot".

entries.seedCode: part of the world (Seed Code, preset, history)

en.short: Whether a replacement may be larger than the spot it stands in.
en.what: "Only where they fit" never puts an enemy into a spot smaller than the enemy; with Only bosses a spot that is too small for every boss stays as it is. "Anywhere" allows any size, with a higher risk of enemies clipping into walls or getting stuck.
en.affects: Which replacements a spot can take.
en.limits: Only used with the placement method "Pick a replacement for every spot".

pl.short: Czy zamiennik może być większy niż miejsce, w którym stoi.

fits.label: Only where they fit
fits.explanation: A replacement is never larger than the spot.

anywhere-except-npcs.label: Anywhere, NPC spots excepted
anywhere-except-npcs.explanation: For regular enemies the same as Anywhere (it only differs for NPC spots, which are never replaced).

dependencies.text: Turn on Enemy randomization to change this option.
Turn on Regular enemies to change this option.
Only used with the placement method "Pick a replacement for every spot".

entries.seedCode: part of the world (Seed Code, preset, history)

en.short: Whether replacements follow the difficulty of the place.
en.what: Difficulty curve: a regular enemy is replaced by one of comparable difficulty (how far it may differ is set by strictness). Random: any enemy anywhere. Easy Asylum (a modifier of the two modes above): the regular spots of the Undead Asylum receive only the easiest candidates, every other map follows the mode it is combined with. Bosses are never among the easiest candidates, so with Only bosses the Undead Asylum stays as it is (and is not given regular enemies either). DS1TR derives the difficulty classes from the enemies' areas and health, so they approximate the original ones.
en.affects: Which enemy can stand where.
en.limits: Only used with the placement method "Pick a replacement for every spot".

pl.short: Czy zamienniki mają podążać za trudnością miejsca.

curve-easy-asylum.label: Comparable difficulty, easy Asylum
curve-easy-asylum.explanation: Comparable difficulty, and only the easiest enemies in the Asylum.

random-easy-asylum.label: Random, easy Asylum
random-easy-asylum.explanation: Any enemy anywhere, except that the Asylum gets only the easiest.

random.label: Fully random
random.explanation: Any enemy anywhere, also in the Asylum.

dependencies.text: Turn on Enemy randomization to change this option.
Turn on Regular enemies to change this option.
Only used with the placement method "Pick a replacement for every spot".

entries.seedCode: part of the world (Seed Code, preset, history)

en.short: How far from the original difficulty a replacement may be.
en.what: Used by the difficulty curve modes. Strict: mostly the same difficulty class, harder enemies are rare. A bit loose: harder enemies appear more often. Very loose: any difficulty can appear anywhere.
en.affects: Enemy difficulty in each area.
en.limits: Only used with a difficulty curve mode.

pl.short: Jak bardzo zamiennik może odbiegać od oryginalnej trudności.

strict.label: Strict
strict.explanation: Mostly the same difficulty; harder ones are rare.

dependencies.text: Turn on Enemy randomization to change this option.
Only used when Difficulty matching is one of the difficulty curve modes.
Turn on Regular enemies to change this option.
Only used with the placement method "Pick a replacement for every spot".

entries.seedCode: part of the world (Seed Code, preset, history)

en.short: Replaces all enemies of one kind in a map with the same new kind.
en.what: Enabled: every enemy of one kind in a map (every Hollow in the Undead Parish) becomes the same new kind, and two kinds in one map never get the same replacement. The replacement chance then applies to the kind. With bosses in regular spots, Enabled gives every enemy of one kind the same boss; the exception lets each spot draw its own boss.
en.affects: How uniform the enemies of a map look.
en.limits: Only used with the placement method "Pick a replacement for every spot".
en.example: All Hollows in the Parish become Balder Knights.

pl.short: Zastępuje wszystkich wrogów jednego rodzaju na mapie tym samym nowym rodzajem.

enabled.label: Same replacement for each kind
enabled.explanation: All enemies of one kind in a map get the same replacement.

enabled-except-roaming-bosses.label: Same, except roaming bosses
enabled-except-roaming-bosses.explanation: As Enabled, but every spot that receives a roaming boss draws its own boss.

dependencies.text: Turn on Enemy randomization to change this option.
Turn on Regular enemies to change this option.
Only used with the placement method "Pick a replacement for every spot".

entries.serializedValues: null, or a list of model ids
entries.seedCode: part of the world (Seed Code, preset, history)

en.short: Limits which enemies may be used as replacements.
en.what: Choose the regular enemies the sampler may place. Enemies you do not select are never removed from their places; they are only not used as replacements elsewhere.
en.affects: The pool of replacement candidates for regular enemies.
en.limits: Only used with the placement method "Pick a replacement for every spot". Choosing a custom pool turns Hostile NPCs off.

pl.short: Ogranicza, których wrogów można użyć jako zamienników.

dependencies.text: Turn on Enemy randomization to change this option.
Turn on Regular enemies to change this option.
Only used with the placement method "Pick a replacement for every spot".

entries.seedCode: part of the world (Seed Code, preset, history)

en.short: Replaces bosses with other bosses.
en.what: Bosses are replaced according to Boss replacement. Some boss fights (the dragons, the multi-body bosses) are exchanged only as whole groups.
en.affects: Every boss fight.
en.limits: Needs Enemy randomization turned on.

pl.short: Zastępuje bossów innymi bossami.

dependencies.text: Turn on Enemy randomization to change this option.

entries.seedCode: part of the world (Seed Code, preset, history)

en.short: How boss arenas are filled.
en.what: Classic shuffle exchanges the bosses between the boss arenas. Random bosses lets every single-body boss arena draw its own replacement, so a boss can appear more than once. The two options with regular enemies let a regular enemy stand in as the body of three early fights (Asylum Demon, Taurus Demon, Capra Demon): the fight stays the boss's (its health bar and name, its fog gate, what it unlocks and its rewards) and the regular enemy never comes back.
en.affects: Which boss or enemy appears in each boss arena. The dragons, Seath, Priscilla, the Sanctuary Guardian, the Bell Gargoyles and the Centipede Demon keep the classic shuffle.
en.limits: Needs Boss randomization and the placement method "Pick a replacement for every spot". Lord Gwyn follows "Lord Gwyn as a replacement boss".

pl.short: Jak wypełniane są areny bossów.

classic.label: Shuffle between arenas
classic.explanation: Bosses are shuffled between the arenas, as in earlier versions.

bosses.label: Random bosses
bosses.explanation: Every arena draws its own boss; a boss can appear more than once.

normals.label: Regular enemy in early fights
normals.explanation: The three early fights get a regular enemy as their body; every other boss stays its own.

both.label: Bosses or regular enemies
both.explanation: Those three fights may get a regular enemy; every other arena gets a random boss.

dependencies.text: Turn on Boss randomization to change this option.
Turn on Enemy randomization to change this option.
Only used with the placement method "Pick a replacement for every spot".

entries.seedCode: part of the world (Seed Code, preset, history)

labels.en: Boss chance where a regular enemy may stand
labels.pl: Szansa na bossa tam, gdzie może stanąć zwykły wróg

en.short: How often a boss arena that can take a regular enemy gets a boss.
en.what: Of the boss arenas that take part and can take a regular enemy, this share gets a boss; the rest get a regular enemy.
en.affects: The three early fights that can have a regular enemy as their body.
en.limits: Needs "Boss replacement" set to "Bosses or regular enemies".

pl.short: Jak często arena, która może przyjąć zwykłego wroga, dostaje bossa.

dependencies.text: Turn on Boss randomization to change this option.
Turn on Enemy randomization to change this option.
Needs "Boss replacement" set to "Bosses or regular enemies".
Only used with the placement method "Pick a replacement for every spot".

entries.seedCode: part of the world (Seed Code, preset, history)

en.short: Every boss is used once before any boss appears a second time.
en.what: Every boss of the pool is placed once before any boss is used again.
en.affects: The bosses drawn for boss arenas.
en.limits: Needs "Boss replacement" set to "Random bosses" or "Bosses or regular enemies".

en.short: Enemy and boss strength follows how far an area is from the start.
en.what: The health and damage of enemies and bosses in an area are adjusted by how far that area ends up from the start compared with the original game, so an area that comes earlier is easier and one that comes later is harder. Areas that come early in the original game are not made easier.
